subject: health

location.unitTitle: Sexual Health, Disease Prevention, and Community Action

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain reproductive health concepts in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of pregnancy and infection prevention concepts.
Apply testing and healthcare supports in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving consent and coercion; correct it and explain why.
Connect reproductive health concepts with health advocacy and respectful communication. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Complete a fact-checked community-health project with family review choices, private questions, and no disclosure requirement.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Sexual Health, Disease Prevention, and Community Action?
